results.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
results.long_description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. operates as a bank and financial holding company in the United States, rest of North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Caribbean. It operates in three segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management. The company offers deposit, investment and lending products, and cash management; mortgage origination and servicing activities; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and credit cards, payment solutions, travel services, merchant offers, lifestyle benefits, auto loans, and leases to consumers and small businesses through bank branches, ATMs, and digital and telephone banking. It also provides investment banking, market-making, financing, custody, and securities products and services; corporate strategy and structure advisory, equity and debt market capital-raising, and loan origination and syndication services; cash and derivative instruments, risk management solutions, prime brokerage, clearing, and research; and fund services, liquidity and trading services, and data solutions products for large corporations, financial institutions, merchants, start-ups, small and midsized companies, local governments, municipalities, nonprofits, and commercial real estate clients. In addition, the company offers multi-asset investment management solutions in equities, fixed income, alternatives, and money market funds to institutional clients and retail investors; retirement products and services, estate planning, lending, deposits, and investment management products to high-net-worth clients; and financial transaction processing. JPMorgan Chase & Co. was founded in 1799 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

growth_total_revenue.label: Total Revenue
growth_total_revenue.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

growth_amortization_expense.label: Amortization Expense
growth_amortization_expense.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Depreciation and Amortization minus explicitly mapped children.

growth_depreciation_and_amortization.label: Depreciation and Amortization
growth_depreciation_and_amortization.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.

growth_other_operating_expenses.label: Other Operating Expenses
growth_other_operating_expenses.description: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

growth_loans_and_lease_interest_income.label: Loans and Leases Interest Income
growth_loans_and_lease_interest_income.description: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other revolving-type loans and (2) loans and leases held-for-sale which may include mortgage loans, direct financing, and sales-type leases.

growth_investment_securities_interest_in.label: Investment Securities Interest Income
growth_investment_securities_interest_in.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

growth_deposits_interest_income.label: Deposits and Money Market Investments Interest Income
growth_deposits_interest_income.description: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

growth_fed_funds_and_repo_interest_incom.label: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Borrowed Interest Income
growth_fed_funds_and_repo_interest_incom.description: The aggregate interest income earned from (1) the lending of excess federal funds to another commercial bank requiring such for its legal reserve requirements and (2) securities purchased under agreements to resell.

growth_trading_account_interest_income.label: Trading Account Interest Income
growth_trading_account_interest_income.description: Interest and dividend income on securities that are bought and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term ("trading securities") and on securities measured at fair value through earnings.

growth_other_interest_income.label: Other Interest Income
growth_other_interest_income.description: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

growth_total_interest_income.label: Total Interest Income
growth_total_interest_income.description: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

growth_deposits_interest_expense.label: Deposits Interest Expense
growth_deposits_interest_expense.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

growth_short_term_borrowing_interest_exp.label: Short-Term Borrowings Interest Expense
growth_short_term_borrowing_interest_exp.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

growth_long_term_debt_interest_expense.label: Long-Term Debt Interest Expense
growth_long_term_debt_interest_expense.description: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

growth_fed_funds_and_repo_interest_expen.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold Interest Expense
growth_fed_funds_and_repo_interest_expen.description: The aggregate expense incurred on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase. If amounts recognized as payables under repurchase agreements have been offset against amounts recognized as receivables under reverse repurchase agreements and reported as a net amount on the balance sheet, the income and expense from these agreements may be reported on a net basis.

growth_other_interest_expense.label: Other Interest Expense
growth_other_interest_expense.description: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

growth_total_interest_expense.label: Total Interest Expense
growth_total_interest_expense.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

growth_net_interest_income.label: Net Interest Income / (Expense)
growth_net_interest_income.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

growth_revenues_excl_interest_dividends.label: Revenues Excluding Interest and Dividends
growth_revenues_excl_interest_dividends.description: Revenue excluding interest and dividend income (securities firms).

growth_trust_fee_income.label: Trust Fees by Commissions
growth_trust_fee_income.description: Revenue recognized in the period for (1) performance (incentive) fees based on the investment results achieved for management of certain institutional accounts and hedge funds, (2) schedule-based fees earned for management of mutual funds and closed-end funds, based either on average daily net assets or on a combination of the average daily net assets and gross income, and (3) other investment management and advisory fees.

growth_service_charges_on_deposits_incom.label: Service Charges on Deposit Accounts
growth_service_charges_on_deposits_incom.description: Includes amounts charged depositors for: (1) maintenance of their accounts (maintenance charges); (2) failure to maintain specified minimum balances on account; (3) exceeding the number of checks or transactions allowed to be processed in a given period; (4) checks drawn on no minimum balance deposit accounts; (5) withdrawals from nontransaction deposit accounts; (6) closing savings accounts before a specified minimum period of time has elapsed; (7) accounts which have remained inactive for extended periods of time or which have become dormant; (8) use of automated teller machines or remote service units; (9) checks drawn against insufficient funds that the bank assesses regardless of whether it decides to pay, return or hold the check; (10) issuing stop payment orders; (11) certifying checks; and (12) accumulating or disbursing funds deposited in IRAs or Keogh Plan accounts when not handled by the bank's trust department. This item does not include penalties assessed on the early withdrawal of time deposits.

growth_other_service_charge_income.label: Other Service Charges
growth_other_service_charge_income.description: Fee and commission revenue earned from sources not otherwise specified in the existing taxonomy.

growth_net_realized_capital_gains.label: Net Realized & Unrealized Capital Gains on Investments
growth_net_realized_capital_gains.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

growth_investment_banking_income.label: Investment Banking Income
growth_investment_banking_income.description: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

growth_other_noninterest_income.label: Other Non-Interest Income
growth_other_noninterest_income.description: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

growth_total_noninterest_income.label: Total Non-Interest Income
growth_total_noninterest_income.description: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

growth_provision_for_credit_losses.label: Provision for Credit Losses
growth_provision_for_credit_losses.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

growth_net_interest_income_after_provisi.label: Net Interest Income After Provision for Loan Losses
growth_net_interest_income_after_provisi.description: Amount of net interest income after provision for credit losses.

growth_salaries_and_employee_benefits_ex.label: Salaries and Employee Benefits
growth_salaries_and_employee_benefits_ex.description: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

growth_net_occupancy_equipment_expense.label: Net Occupancy & Equipment Expense
growth_net_occupancy_equipment_expense.description: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

growth_total_noninterest_expense.label: Total Non-Interest Expense
growth_total_noninterest_expense.description: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

growth_other_gains.label: Other Gains / (Losses), net
growth_other_gains.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

growth_other_pretax_income.label: Other Pre-Tax Income
growth_other_pretax_income.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Total Pre-Tax Income  minus explicitly mapped children.

growth_total_pretax_income.label: Total Pre-Tax Income
growth_total_pretax_income.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

growth_income_tax_expense.label: Income Tax Expense
growth_income_tax_expense.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

growth_net_income_continuing.label: Net Income / (Loss) Continuing Operations
growth_net_income_continuing.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_extraordinary_income.label: Extraordinary Income / (Loss), net
growth_extraordinary_income.description: Description of the gains (losses), after tax, arising from an event or transaction that is both unusual in nature and infrequent in occurrence when considered in relation to the environment in which the entity operates and which represents the portion assigned to noncontrolling interest, if any. This amount is the income statement amount which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).

growth_other_adjustments_to_consolidated.label: Other Adjustments to Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)
growth_other_adjustments_to_consolidated.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

growth_net_income.label: Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)
growth_net_income.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_preferred_dividends.label: Preferred Stock Dividends Declared
growth_preferred_dividends.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

growth_other_adjustments_to_net_income_t.label: Other Adjustment to Net Income / (Loss) Attributable to Common Shareholders)
growth_other_adjustments_to_net_income_t.description: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

growth_net_income_to_common.label: Net Income / (Loss) Attributable to Common Shareholders
growth_net_income_to_common.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

growth_weighted_ave_basic_shares_os.label: Weighted Average Basic Shares Outstanding
growth_weighted_ave_basic_shares_os.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

growth_basic_eps.label: Basic Earnings per Share
growth_basic_eps.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

growth_weighted_ave_diluted_shares_os.label: Weighted Average Diluted Shares Outstanding
growth_weighted_ave_diluted_shares_os.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

growth_diluted_eps.label: Diluted Earnings per Share
growth_diluted_eps.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

growth_cash_dividends_per_share.label: Cash Dividends to Common per Share
growth_cash_dividends_per_share.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

growth_cash_and_equivalents.label: Cash and Due from Banks
growth_cash_and_equivalents.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

growth_restricted_cash.label: Restricted Cash
growth_restricted_cash.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

growth_fed_funds_sold.label: Federal Funds Sold
growth_fed_funds_sold.description: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements (Federal Funds Sold) and (2) the dollar amount outstanding of funds lent in the form of security resale agreements regardless of maturity, if the agreement requires the bank to resell the identical security purchased or a security that meets the definition of substantially the same in the case of a dollar roll. Also include purchases of participations in pools of securities, regardless of maturity (Securities Purchased Under Agreements to Re-sell).

growth_interest_bearing_deposits_at_othe.label: Interest Bearing Deposits at Other Banks
growth_interest_bearing_deposits_at_othe.description: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

growth_trading_account_securities.label: Trading Account Securities
growth_trading_account_securities.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

growth_loans_and_leases.label: Loans and Leases
growth_loans_and_leases.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

growth_allowance_for_loan_and_lease_loss.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses
growth_allowance_for_loan_and_lease_loss.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

growth_other_net_loans_and_leases.label: Other Loans and Leases, Net of Allowance
growth_other_net_loans_and_leases.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Loans and Leases, Net of Allowance minus explicitly mapped children.

growth_net_loans_and_leases.label: Loans and Leases, Net of Allowance
growth_net_loans_and_leases.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

growth_loans_held_for_sale.label: Loans Held for Sale
growth_loans_held_for_sale.description: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

growth_net_ppe.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
growth_net_ppe.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets.

growth_net_premises_and_equipment.label: Premises and Equipment, Net
growth_net_premises_and_equipment.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

growth_operating_lease_right_of_use_asse.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
growth_operating_lease_right_of_use_asse.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

growth_mortgage_servicing_rights.label: Mortgage Servicing Rights
growth_mortgage_servicing_rights.description: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.

growth_goodwill.label: Goodwill
growth_goodwill.description: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

growth_intangible_assets.label: Intangible Assets
growth_intangible_assets.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

growth_other_assets.label: Other Assets
growth_other_assets.description: Amount of assets classified as other.

growth_total_assets.label: Total Assets
growth_total_assets.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

growth_noninterest_bearing_deposits.label: Non-Interest Bearing Deposits
growth_noninterest_bearing_deposits.description: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

growth_interest_bearing_deposits.label: Interest Bearing Deposits
growth_interest_bearing_deposits.description: The aggregate of all domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposit liabilities.

growth_fed_funds_purchased.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold
growth_fed_funds_purchased.description: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

growth_short_term_debt.label: Short-Term Debt
growth_short_term_debt.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_accounts_payable.label: Accounts Payable
growth_accounts_payable.description: Amount of obligations incurred and payable for goods and services received.

growth_other_short_term_payables.label: Other Short-Term Payables
growth_other_short_term_payables.description: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_long_term_debt.label: Long-Term Debt
growth_long_term_debt.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

growth_other_long_term_liabilities.label: Other Long-Term Liabilities
growth_other_long_term_liabilities.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_total_liabilities.label: Total Liabilities
growth_total_liabilities.description: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

growth_total_preferred_equity.label: Preferred Stock
growth_total_preferred_equity.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

growth_common_equity.label: Common Stock
growth_common_equity.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

growth_additional_paid_in_capital.label: Additional Paid-In Capital
growth_additional_paid_in_capital.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

growth_treasury_stock.label: Treasury Stock
growth_treasury_stock.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

growth_accumulated_other_comprehensive_i.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income / (Loss)
growth_accumulated_other_comprehensive_i.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

growth_other_equity.label: Other Equity Adjustments
growth_other_equity.description: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

growth_total_common_equity.label: Total Common Equity
growth_total_common_equity.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

growth_total_equity.label: Total Preferred & Common Equity
growth_total_equity.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

growth_total_equity_and_noncontrolling_i.label: Total Equity & Noncontrolling Interests
growth_total_equity_and_noncontrolling_i.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

growth_total_liabilities_and_equity.label: Total Liabilities & Shareholders' Equity
growth_total_liabilities_and_equity.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

growth_net_income.label: Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)
growth_net_income.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_other_net_income_continuing.label: Other Net Income / (Loss) Continuing Operations
growth_other_net_income_continuing.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Net Income / (Loss) Continuing Operations minus explicitly mapped children.

growth_net_income_continuing.label: Net Income / (Loss) Continuing Operations
growth_net_income_continuing.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

growth_provision_for_loan_losses.label: Provision For Loan Losses
growth_provision_for_loan_losses.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

growth_amortization_expense.label: Amortization Expense
growth_amortization_expense.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
growth_other_depreciation_and_amortizati.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Depreciation and Amortization minus explicitly mapped children.

growth_depreciation_and_amortization.label: Depreciation and Amortization
growth_depreciation_and_amortization.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.

growth_stock_based_compensation.label: Stock-Based Compensation
growth_stock_based_compensation.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

growth_deferred_income_tax.label: Deferred Income Tax
growth_deferred_income_tax.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

growth_gain_loss_on_investments.label: Gain / (Loss) on Investments
growth_gain_loss_on_investments.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

growth_noncash_adjustments_to_net_income.label: Non-Cash Adjustments to Reconcile Net Income
growth_noncash_adjustments_to_net_income.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

growth_other_operating_activities.label: Other Operating Activities
growth_other_operating_activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

growth_change_in_other_operating_assets_.label: Change in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, net
growth_change_in_other_operating_assets_.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

growth_increase_decrease_in_operating_ca.label: Changes in Operating Assets and Liabilities, net
growth_increase_decrease_in_operating_ca.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

growth_net_cash_from_continuing_operatin.label: Net Cash From Continuing Operating Activities
growth_net_cash_from_continuing_operatin.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

growth_net_cash_from_operating_activitie.label: Net Cash From Operating Activities
growth_net_cash_from_operating_activitie.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

growth_acquisitions.label: Acquisitions
growth_acquisitions.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

growth_purchase_of_investments.label: Purchase of Investment Securities
growth_purchase_of_investments.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

growth_purchase_of_held_to_maturity_inve.label: Purchase of Held-to-Maturity Investments
growth_purchase_of_held_to_maturity_inve.description: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

growth_sale_of_investments.label: Sale of Investments
growth_sale_of_investments.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

growth_maturity_of_investments.label: Maturity of Investment Securities
growth_maturity_of_investments.description: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

growth_net_increase_in_fed_funds_sold.label: Net Increase in Fed Funds Sold
growth_net_increase_in_fed_funds_sold.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

growth_loans_held_for_sale_net.label: Loans Held for Sale, Net
growth_loans_held_for_sale_net.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

growth_other_investing_activities_net.label: Other Investing Activities, net
growth_other_investing_activities_net.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

growth_net_cash_from_continuing_investin.label: Net Cash From Continuing Investing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_continuing_investin.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

growth_net_cash_from_investing_activitie.label: Net Cash From Investing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_investing_activitie.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

growth_repayment_of_debt.label: Repayment of Debt
growth_repayment_of_debt.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

growth_repurchase_of_preferred_equity.label: Repurchase of Preferred Equity
growth_repurchase_of_preferred_equity.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

growth_repurchase_of_common_equity.label: Repurchase of Common Equity
growth_repurchase_of_common_equity.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

growth_payment_of_dividends.label: Payment of Dividends
growth_payment_of_dividends.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

growth_issuance_of_debt.label: Issuance of Debt
growth_issuance_of_debt.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

growth_issuance_of_preferred_equity.label: Issuance of Preferred Equity
growth_issuance_of_preferred_equity.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

growth_issuance_of_common_equity.label: Issuance of Common Equity
growth_issuance_of_common_equity.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

growth_net_change_in_deposits.label: Net Change in Deposits
growth_net_change_in_deposits.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

growth_other_financing_activities_net.label: Other Financing Activities, Net
growth_other_financing_activities_net.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

growth_net_cash_from_continuing_financin.label: Net Cash From Continuing Financing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_continuing_financin.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

growth_net_cash_from_financing_activitie.label: Net Cash From Financing Activities
growth_net_cash_from_financing_activitie.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

growth_effect_of_exchange_rate_changes.label: Effect of Exchange Rate Changes
growth_effect_of_exchange_rate_changes.description: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances held in foreign currencies.

growth_net_change_in_cash.label: Net Change in Cash & Equivalents
growth_net_change_in_cash.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash and cash equivalents. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a debit balance consistent with its label.

growth_cash_at_beginning_of_period.label: Cash at Beginning of Period
growth_cash_at_beginning_of_period.description: Cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and restricted cash equivalents at the beginning of the reporting period. Derived from the previous period's ending balance.

growth_cash_at_end_of_period.label: Cash at End of Period
growth_cash_at_end_of_period.description: Cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and restricted cash equivalents at the end of the reporting period.

growth_cash_interest_paid.label: Cash Interest Paid
growth_cash_interest_paid.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

growth_cash_income_taxes_paid.label: Cash Income Taxes Paid
growth_cash_income_taxes_paid.description: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

growth_short_term_debt_net.label: Short-Term Debt, net
growth_short_term_debt_net.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
